facts.text: Located close to various hyperspace routes, Bracca's strategic importance made it the site of a campaign during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Located close to various hyperspace routes, Bracca's strategic importance made it the site of a campaign during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Scrapper Guild operated on the planet, breaking down starship wreckage and selling the components to the Empire.

evidence.quote: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Scrapper Guild operated on the planet, breaking down starship wreckage and selling the components to the Empire.

facts.text: Bracca was a poor Mid Rim world dominated by rocky plains.

evidence.quote: Bracca was a poor Mid Rim world dominated by rocky plains.

facts.text: Large swathes of the planet's surface were comprised of junkyards, with countless decommissioned starships and other machinery spread haphazardly, awaiting destruction.

evidence.quote: Large swathes of the planet's surface were comprised of junkyards, with countless decommissioned starships and other machinery spread haphazardly, awaiting destruction.

facts.text: It was orbited by one moon.

evidence.quote: It was orbited by one moon.

facts.text: Given the generally inhospitable nature of the world, the majority of its population was comprised of scrappers, who made their living breaking down and selling the trash left on the world.

evidence.quote: Given the generally inhospitable nature of the world, the majority of its population was comprised of scrappers, who made their living breaking down and selling the trash left on the world.

facts.text: The Scrapper Guild used to fix and build starships, hiring many engineers, but by the fifth year of the Imperial Era, engineers had turned into scrappers.

evidence.quote: The Scrapper Guild used to fix and build starships, hiring many engineers, but by the fifth year of the Imperial Era, engineers had turned into scrappers.

facts.text: Nearly all services on Bracca were operated by the Scrapper Guild.

evidence.quote: Nearly all services on Bracca were operated by the Scrapper Guild.

facts.text: Credits earned in a workday were quickly recouped by the Guild due to the prices for food, lodging, and other necessities.
entities: The Art of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order

evidence.quote: Credits earned in a workday were quickly recouped by the Guild due to the prices for food, lodging, and other necessities.

facts.text: The planet's spaceports exported supplies from the scrapyards to the Core Worlds; these supplies were delivered by an extensive system of high-speed transport trains criss-crossing Bracca's surface.

evidence.quote: The planet's spaceports exported supplies from the scrapyards to the Core Worlds; these supplies were delivered by an extensive system of high-speed transport trains criss-crossing Bracca's surface.

facts.text: Mygoras were large creatures that lived in the junkyards of Bracca, using pieces of scrap as body armor.

evidence.quote: Mygoras were large creatures that lived in the junkyards of Bracca, using pieces of scrap as body armor.

facts.text: Bisnus were smaller, but also lived in the junkyards; they were an egg-laying quadruped with purple skin and gray fur.

evidence.quote: Bisnus were smaller, but also lived in the junkyards; they were an egg-laying quadruped with purple skin and gray fur.

facts.text: Throughout the High Republic Era, Bracca was predominantly operated by independent scrappers, who worked under a "finders-keepers" dynamic.

evidence.quote: Throughout the High Republic Era, Bracca was predominantly operated by independent scrappers, who worked under a "finders-keepers" dynamic.
